• Design, build, and maintain the production data models that power supply chain and merchandising decisions: sales and demand, inventory position and in-stock, damage and expiration, turn, vendor fill rate, purchase orders, and allocation.

  • Be the go-to data expert for these domains, with a deep understanding of our data warehouse and the processing layers feeding it.

  • Partner with Supply Chain divisional teams, Merchandising, Marketing, CRM, product managers, and engineers to translate business questions into durable models and self-serve tooling rather than one-off pulls.

  • Own data integrity, availability, transformation logic, and efficient data access for the domains you support.

  • Build and maintain reporting and dashboards in Looker that planners and merchants use daily, and retire the manual reporting they replace.

  • Support marketing and CRM analytics alongside the supply chain work: campaign and promotion performance, channel reporting.

  • Identify gaps in existing data, write data product specs, and work with engineering teams to get the right tracking in place.

  • Automate wherever possible, and build testing and monitoring so data quality problems surface before stakeholders find them.

  • Document your models so every stakeholder can find, understand, and trust the data without asking you first.

• Experience with ETL/ELT tooling (bonus points for dbt).

  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, big data technologies, and analytics platforms. Snowflake, Redshift, and/or Azure experience strongly preferred.

  • Exposure to supply chain, inventory, merchandise planning, or allocation data. You don't need years of planning experience, but familiarity with concepts like model stock, lead time, replenishment cycles, sell-through, and turn will get you productive faster.

  • Experience with marketing or CRM analytics: campaign performance, promotion lift, channel attribution, or customer segmentation.

  • Experience with demand planning or ERP systems such as JustEnough or Kinaxis.

  • Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools. We use assistants like Claude in our day-to-day analytics engineering work, and we value engineers who use them well: accelerating model development, SQL review, testing, and documentation while independently verifying outputs and knowing when the tool is the wrong answer.

  • Alcohol beverage or CPG category experience is a plus.

• Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or another quantitative discipline.

  • 3+ years of experience building data models that integrate complex and disparate data sources, using tools such as dbt.

  • Expert in SQL and database table design, able to write structured and efficient queries against large datasets. Advanced Excel skills for partner collaboration.

  • 1+ years building and maintaining reporting and dashboards in Looker or a comparable BI tool.

  • Strong analytical judgment: able to move from raw data to a clear recommendation, and to explain the 'so what' to business partners who will act on it.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into tractable work items and to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical partners.

  • Top-notch organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Move fast, be a team player, always be learning, and give back.

Gopuff is seeking a Forklift Operations Associate (FOA) to join the Distribution Center team. We are looking for motivated and committed individuals. You will play an essential role in our Distribution Center, which requires drive, positivity, and enthusiasm for the challenge. Reporting to the Area Manager, you will accomplish a variety of warehouse responsibilities, including stacking and storing merchandise while using a forklift, clamps, and push-pull equipment.
 
Customers turn to Gopuff to provide their everyday essentials—day and night, rain or shine. We're assembling a team of thinkers, dreamers, and risk takers who are ready to help us reshape the world of retail faster than ever before. And it doesn't hurt if you like snacks.
 
You Will:
-Load and unload freight
-Stacks and stores merchandise in designated areas using a forklift, clamp, push-pull equipment. Unload inbound shipments safely and move product to storage locations
-Pulls and prepares products for shipment
-Operate material handling equipment
-Complete inspection forms prior to operating equipment. Report safety concerns to management
-Maintain Warehouse Organizational Standards
-Ensure the Standards of Conduct policy is followed to provide a safe and inclusive work environment
-Assist Area Manager and Leads with all warehouse tasks when delegated 
 
You Have:
-High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
-1+ years of high-reach forklift experience
-2+ years of warehouse, logistics, military, or equivalent experience
-General working knowledge of basic web-based software applications (e.g., Google G-Suite)
-Ability to lift up to 49 lbs.
 
We care about our team and want to make sure you know what to expect:
-Handle, scan, and move product in a safe and well-organized manner
-Stand, push, pull, squat, bend, reach, and walk during shifts
-Use carts, pallet jacks, dollies, and other equipment to move product
-Lift up to 49 pounds. Handle products that may contain tobacco, nicotine, and/or alcohol
-Work in freezer locations periodically throughout shifts

descriptionPlain:
Gopuff is seeking a Forklift Operations Associate (FOA) to join the Distribution Center team. We are looking for motivated and committed individuals. You will play an essential role in our Distribution Center, which requires drive, positivity, and enthusiasm for the challenge. Reporting to the Area Manager, you will accomplish a variety of warehouse responsibilities, including stacking and storing merchandise while using a forklift, clamps, and push-pull equipment.
 
Customers turn to Gopuff to provide their everyday essentials—day and night, rain or shine. We're assembling a team of thinkers, dreamers, and risk takers who are ready to help us reshape the world of retail faster than ever before. And it doesn't hurt if you like snacks.
 
You Will:
-Load and unload freight
-Stacks and stores merchandise in designated areas using a forklift, clamp, push-pull equipment. Unload inbound shipments safely and move product to storage locations
-Pulls and prepares products for shipment
-Operate material handling equipment
-Complete inspection forms prior to operating equipment. Report safety concerns to management
-Maintain Warehouse Organizational Standards
-Ensure the Standards of Conduct policy is followed to provide a safe and inclusive work environment
-Assist Area Manager and Leads with all warehouse tasks when delegated 
 
You Have:
-High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
-1+ years of high-reach forklift experience
-2+ years of warehouse, logistics, military, or equivalent experience
-General working knowledge of basic web-based software applications (e.g., Google G-Suite)
-Ability to lift up to 49 lbs.
 
We care about our team and want to make sure you know what to expect:
-Handle, scan, and move product in a safe and well-organized manner
-Stand, push, pull, squat, bend, reach, and walk during shifts
-Use carts, pallet jacks, dollies, and other equipment to move product
-Lift up to 49 pounds. Handle products that may contain tobacco, nicotine, and/or alcohol
-Work in freezer locations periodically throughout shifts

lists.content:
• Work directly with senior leadership to help scale, optimise, and lead key business verticals
    and strategic initiatives across the US business.
  • Own the execution and performance management of growth strategies, pricing, merchandising, and operational initiatives within your assigned vertical. 
  • Monitor vertical performance daily, rapidly troubleshoot operational or commercial bottlenecks, and proactively implement solutions to drive growth, profitability, and customer experience.
  • Build and maintain trackers, forecasting models, reporting frameworks, and weekly business reviews (WBRs) to drive operational rigour and support executive decision-making.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses on category performance, pricing, customer behaviour, and unit economics to identify growth opportunities and improve commercial efficiency.
  • Support partnership management by coordinating with key external partners, contributing to commercial negotiations, and optimising joint business opportunities. 
  • Evaluate financial performance, monitor investment efficiency, and ensure the profitable allocation of resources across your business area.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Commercial, Finance, Marketing, Product, Supply Chain, and Operations teams to execute high-impact growth initiatives.

• 1–3 years of experience in a high-growth startup, consulting, finance, e-commerce, or commercial role. 
  • A natural problem-solver with a strong bias for action and a flexible mindset.
  • Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to quickly translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations.
  • Strong leadership and collaborative skills with a track record of influencing diverse stakeholders. 
  • Experience with leading strategic planning and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience supporting partnership management, negotiating commercial initiatives, or driving profitable business growth.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets, with experience building forecasts, trackers, and performance reporting.
  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• We want to help our employees stay safe and healthy. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision and Mental health support to all eligible employees.

  • Gopuff employee rewards (including some great brand partnership deals)
